data.name: Minimo
data.detailed_description:
Featured by IGN. 60,000+ wishlists and climbing. 4.6 / 5 likelihood to recommend from playtesters.

What playtesters are saying:

  • "This is an absolutely unhinged idea and I love it very much"

  • "Well this is gonna blow up"

  • "10/10 fishing is one of my fav classes"

  • "This is... an actually original concept!"

  • "I was already hopeful for this game, but now hope has made sense for certainty."

Picture the starting gun of a fresh MMO server firing every 30 minutes. Minimo takes what made the opening hours of an MMO magical, the massive boss fights, the class synergies, the crafting and the exploring, and compresses it into a single self-contained run you can finish in one sitting. 200 players share one world, chase the same clock, and reshape it for everyone as they go. Some runs are a focused race for records and new bosses. Some are just the good kind of fun.

Work together to unlock new regions, uncover secrets, and face colossal bosses! Completing quests expands the world with tougher encounters and new challenges.

The world shifts with every run - with new paths, encounters, and challenges to overcome. Vote between upgrades to improve your combat skills, survival skills, or craftsmanship. Every choice you make shapes the journey - for you and everyone else!

50 different classes shape how you explore, fight, and progress! Relax with your oven mitts, inspire friends with a tune, toss fireballs, or suck the blood of your enemies.

Play solo, with a few friends, or alongside up to 200 other players in a shared run! Join a guild to compete for high scores, race to defeat new bosses, or just jump in and have fun together.

KEY FEATURES

  • Unlock and master 50 distinct classes, each with unique abilities, roles, and playstyles.

  • Team up with other players and combine classes cooperatively to complete quests, solve puzzles, find secrets, and defeat bosses.

  • Explore procedural worlds with fresh layouts, encounters, and surprises every time you play.

  • Each run takes only 30 minutes.

  • Play solo, in small groups, or alongside up to 200 players in shared runs or as a guild.

  • Unlock pets and cosmetic outfits to personalize your character.

  • Vote between hundreds of powerful upgrades, with synergies and wild builds.

  • Everything you do helps everyone - level up together, get stronger, and push further each run.

  • Compete on guild and individual leaderboards.

  • Socialize in a customizable guild space.

  • Yes there is fishing. And cooking. And flower picking. Relax between the chaos with chill activities that still contribute to the run.

data.short_description: The MMO for gamers who need short, fun sessions. Minimo drops 200 players into a shared world for a 30-minute co-op roguelite run: fish, craft, explore, and take down bosses together. Every run is new. Fast adventures. Massive parties.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8800 GT / AMD HD 6850 / Intel HD Graphics 4400 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2014+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU w/ 2 GB VRAM — Intel Iris 6100 / Radeon R9 M370X / Apple M1 integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 or Vulkan compatible GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
